name: Ruined Hilt
description:
A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue.
Its luster has long been lost to the depredations of seawater.
fullDescription: A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue. Its luster has long been lost to the depredations of seawater.\nPerhaps these golems were not first made for battle, though their imperishable forms undoubtedly surpassed that of mortal flesh. Still, even "imperishability" has limits when pitted against time.
